stories.title: Ethereum staking yield now lags cash rates, but investors keep staking
stories.summary: Ethereum staking yield has fallen below cash and short-term rates, CryptoSlate reports. Even so, investors keep adding to staked ETH. The report asks why demand stays strong as the yield edge shrinks.
stories.whyItMatters: Staking yield is a core part of ETH's investment case. A shrinking edge over cash could change institutional demand.
whatToWatch: Further moves in staking yield versus cash rates
Any shift in staking inflows or outflows
ETH ETF plans tied to staking rewards
questions: Why do investors keep staking despite the lower relative yield?
Could a reversal trigger large-scale unstaking?

sources.title: Ethereum staking yield is losing to cash rates, so why are investors still lining up?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $635 million as BTC tests their average cost basis
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $635 million in net outflows, CryptoSlate reports, as bitcoin's price neared the estimated $81,500 average cost basis of ETF holdings. A drop below that level would put many ETF holders at a loss.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows signal institutional sentiment. Sustained outflows near the cost basis could add to selling pressure.
whatToWatch: Whether BTC holds above the $81,500 level
Upcoming daily ETF flow data
Any pickup in outflow pace
questions: Does the cost-basis level act as support, or does price break through it?
Are the outflows concentrated in a few funds?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $635 million as BTC tests their holdings’ estimated $81,500 cost basis

stories.title: JST ecosystem touts buyback-and-burn boost from GasFree revenue and $20M surplus
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports an upgrade to JST's buyback-and-burn mechanism, funded by GasFree revenue and a stated $20.34 million surplus, tied to JUST's wider ecosystem. The report frames the move as support for JST's token value.
stories.whyItMatters: Buyback-and-burn claims often carry a promotional slant. Readers should weigh them against independent data before acting.
whatToWatch: Independent confirmation of the surplus figure
Actual burn execution and supply changes
JST price reaction over coming days
questions: Is the $20.34 million surplus figure independently verified?
How much of this reflects real protocol economics versus marketing?

sources.title: JST Buyback & Burn Upgrade: GasFree Revenue and $20.34M Surplus Injected as JUST’s Ecosystem Trio Solidifies JST Token Value

stories.title: New York seeks $1.3 billion from NovaTech as 11,000 victims await payouts
stories.summary: New York state is demanding $1.3 billion from NovaTech, CryptoSlate reports, in a case tied to roughly 11,000 alleged victims. The action adds further delay before affected investors see any recovery.
stories.whyItMatters: The case shows that past crypto fraud schemes still carry large unresolved liabilities and slow victim restitution.
whatToWatch: Court or settlement developments in the New York action
Any announced timeline for victim payouts
questions: Can NovaTech actually pay $1.3 billion?
How will the roughly 11,000 claims be prioritized?

sources.title: New York demands $1.3B from NovaTech and 11,000 victims face delay

stories.title: New OCC rule resets stablecoin redemption requirements for banks
stories.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has issued a new rule on stablecoin redemptions, CryptoSlate reports. The rule changes how banks must handle redemptions and is expected to require adjustments at affected banks.
stories.whyItMatters: Redemption rules directly affect liquidity and trust in dollar-pegged tokens that underpin much of crypto trading.
whatToWatch: Bank compliance timelines for the new rule
Reaction from stablecoin issuers
Any further OCC guidance
questions: Which banks are most affected by the rule?
Does the change alter redemption speed or cost for users?

sources.title: New OCC stablecoin rule resets redemptions, and banks face big shifts

stories.title: HSBC's RedCoin reaches 3.3 million users, but one rule limits access
stories.summary: HSBC's RedCoin has grown to 3.3 million users, CryptoSlate reports. One strict rule still blocks part of that user base from full access, though the report does not detail the restriction further.
stories.whyItMatters: A major bank's crypto-linked product reaching millions of users signals growing mainstream adoption, even with limits in place.
whatToWatch: Whether HSBC eases or clarifies the access rule
Further user growth figures for RedCoin
questions: What exactly does the rule block users from doing?
Is the restriction a regulatory requirement or a product choice?

sources.title: 3.3M users gain HSBC RedCoin, yet 1 strict rule blocks them

stories.title: Coinbase to delist Japanese yen stablecoin years after crash sparked lawsuits
stories.summary: Coinbase plans to drop a Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin, CryptoSlate reports, years after its price crash led to investor lawsuits. The move comes as exchanges keep reassessing support for stablecoins that have failed to hold their peg.
stories.whyItMatters: Delistings show how exchanges manage legal and reputational risk tied to failed stablecoins.
whatToWatch: Coinbase's delisting timeline and guidance for holders
Status of the related investor lawsuits
questions: How many users still hold the token?
Does the delisting affect the pending litigation?

sources.title: Coinbase to drop this Japanese yen stablecoin years after its price crash sparked investor lawsuits

stories.title: Aave tightens USDT borrowing rules, pushing loan costs higher
stories.summary: Aave has changed its rules for borrowing USDT, CryptoSlate reports, and borrowing costs on the protocol have risen as a result. The change affects users who rely on USDT loans on the platform.
stories.whyItMatters: Rule changes on a major DeFi lending protocol can affect leverage and liquidity across the wider crypto market.
whatToWatch: USDT borrowing rates on Aave in coming days
Any follow-up governance proposals
questions: What exactly changed in the borrowing parameters?
Will other lending protocols make similar changes?

sources.title: Aave changes USDT borrowing rules and loan costs suddenly jump

stories.title: UK's FCA signals crypto apps may need licenses for algorithmic trade routing
stories.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority has said crypto apps that use algorithms to choose trade routes may need a license, CryptoSlate reports. The statement raises new compliance questions for affected platforms.
stories.whyItMatters: Expanded licensing requirements could change which crypto trading apps can legally operate in the UK.
whatToWatch: Formal FCA guidance or rulemaking on this issue
Which platforms confirm they are affected
questions: Which specific routing features trigger the licensing requirement?
What compliance timeline will affected apps face?

sources.title: UK’s FCA says crypto apps may need licenses when algorithms choose trade routes

stories.title: SpaceX perpetual futures see about $6 billion in trading after earnings
stories.summary: Perpetual futures contracts tied to SpaceX traded roughly $6 billion in volume following an earnings event, CryptoSlate reports. The activity shows continued demand for crypto-native derivatives tied to private, non-crypto companies.
stories.whyItMatters: Heavy volume in synthetic exposure to a private company shows crypto derivatives markets expanding beyond crypto assets.
whatToWatch: Whether trading volume holds beyond the post-earnings spike
Any regulatory scrutiny of private-company perpetuals
questions: Who offers these SpaceX perpetual contracts?
How is the underlying price set without a public listing?

sources.title: SpaceX perpetual futures traded about $6 billion after earnings
